basis: The 2005 endpoint is labeled 23.9°C and the 2014 endpoint is labeled 10.1°C, so the full-period change is 10.1 - 23.9 = -13.8°C. This is a large, sustained decrease over the decade (roughly 58% of the starting value), not an ordinary small fluctuation. Since the task's routing criterion is whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, and the measured change is clearly substantial, the substantial-change route is the appropriate public option.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 river temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
